entries.80b588d097b84f0a: A drug that uses the same active ingredient as a new drug (brand-name drug), has been recognized as equivalent in quality, efficacy and safety, and has received government approval.
entries.bbeb67619f68e394: A drug that uses the same active ingredient as a new drug (brand-name drug), has been recognized as equivalent in quality, efficacy and safety, and has received government approval. Because development costs are lower, its price is lower than that of a new drug. It is also called a generic drug.
